CustomField.description: Admin-facing label for what this rule configures - the engine always applies the same formula (requested amount x Rate__c, clamped to Cap__c). "Flat Cap" implies Rate__c left blank (defaults to 100%) with Cap__c set; "Percentage Match" implies Rate__c set with no Cap__c; "Tiered Match" implies multiple rule rows with different Minimum_Amount__c/Maximum_Amount__c brackets.
CustomField.label: Calculation Model
